$comment: MB-27 switch-on D-8 (operator "all recommended" on D-1..D-9; OQ-1..OQ-3 "all recommended"): the closed map from a Phase 2 disclosure family to the one Layer 3 flag word it carries. A base-row disclosure (Layer 2's traceResult, recomputed on read) is matched by the start of its sentence; the first family that matches decides. carry null holds the family to the report (M-35 alternate compliance paths, OQ-2). A sentence of no listed family carries unmapped_word (fail closed, never silence). A stale stamp carries stale_word and nothing is recomputed (D-6 a, guard (i)). Permission disclosures (Layer 2's permissionDisclosuresOf) carry permission.closure_word when the sentence starts with permission.closure_starts_with, else permission.word. The sentences stay in the trace and the report. Increment 3 (decision list DL-16 a, batch 2026-11-06-batch-bc): one closed word per new family, M-435, M-497, M-397, M-190, M-472 and R4-05, each starts_with the wording the ruling itself gives; the Phase 2 or Layer 3 emit of each sentence is built by MB-27.
